name: MuffinEMU Experimental (TrollStore)
subtitle: Unfinished test builds - TrollStore.
description: Wii U on iPhone and iPad, done right. GamePad, TV, or both. Free and open source. These are unfinished test builds, published by hand to try out work in progress. Each one replaces an installed MuffinEMU: it has the same bundle identifier as the standard build, so your games, saves and settings carry over. They can crash or misbehave. For normal play use the Stable source instead. This one is the ad-hoc signed build, with the JIT entitlements embedded, for TrollStore and jailbroken devices.

apps.name: MuffinEMU Experimental
apps.subtitle: Wii U emulator - experimental TrollStore builds
apps.localizedDescription:
Wii U on iPhone and iPad. Play on-screen, use the GamePad, or switch to your TV. Free, open source, and built around Cemu.

Games, keys and system files are not included. Bring the games you own.

- Add games from Files: WUA, WUD/WUX, decrypted or encrypted with your own keys. Updates and DLC install in the app
- HD box art and game info find themselves: summaries, release dates and more
- Download art packs, including 3D boxes, or add your own covers in up to 4K
- Cards, large covers, 3D boxes, grid or list, any size, with sorting, grouping and renaming

[Serious Graphics]
- A Metal renderer built for Apple GPUs, with Vulkan as an option
- Graphic packs, resolution scaling and a brightness boost for dim scenes
- Bring your desktop Cemu shader caches and skip the stutter

[Speed]
- Plays out of the box
- Turn on JIT with StikDebug or LiveContainer for the full-speed recompiler. MuffinEMU offers to do it at launch

[The GamePad, Done Right]
- On-screen controls measured from a real Wii U GamePad, with skins, analog sticks and a layout editor
- Controllers work right alongside it
- One screen or both, iPhone portrait, or the TV picture on an external display

[Online]
- Pretendo Network with your own Wii U account files
- Custom servers, including ones you host at home

[Make It Yours]
- Per-game settings, Basic and Advanced modes, and one-tap settings backup
- 31 app icons with matching themes

Free, open source and updated constantly. Wii U on iOS, the way it should be.

Official Site: https://muffinemu.github.io/MuffinEMU/
Guides: https://muffinemu.github.io/MuffinEMU/docs/
Source code: https://github.com/MuffinEMU/Muffin-EMU
Report a problem: https://github.com/MuffinEMU/Muffin-EMU/issues

Legal

MuffinEMU is not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple. Wii U is a trademark of Nintendo. No copyrighted games, keys or firmware are distributed here.

Experiment: Vulkan page-fault fix
Branch: fix/vulkan-pagefault-mitigations
Commit: 41b8218
Based on: main `d70f299` (v10.0), plus 1 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-14 03:20 UTC

- Vulkan: test mitigations for the GPU page fault

Experiment: Frame rate always on screen
Branch: ui/fps-always-on
Commit: 55e7bff
Based on: main `e4fd402` (v10.0), plus 1 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-13 04:19 UTC

- The frame rate stays on screen when the in-game top bar hides.

Experiment: Direct BC to ASTC
Branch: perf/astc-direct
Commit: a6d86e1
Based on: main `d04b1c8` (v9.9), plus 2 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-13 01:52 UTC

- Most BC textures now convert many times faster on iPhones and iPads without BC texture support, which shortens the freeze when a game loads new textures.
- Normal maps and textures with soft transparency also convert about 2-3 times faster on iPhones and iPads without BC texture support.

Experiment: Direct BC to ASTC
Branch: perf/astc-direct
Commit: 475020f
Based on: main `d04b1c8` (v9.9), plus 1 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-13 00:43 UTC

- Most BC textures now convert many times faster on iPhones and iPads without BC texture support, which shortens the freeze when a game loads new textures.

Experiment: 9.x preview 3
Branch: release/v9.0
Commit: 409b0c5
Based on: main `06c495d` (v9.1), plus 14 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-10 16:48 UTC

- On iPads without mesh shaders, geometry-shader and rectangle draws are now emulated instead of skipped, so effects that were missing show up.
- Make on-screen buttons easier to hit, and size each half separately
- Settings has a new switch, Emulate missing effects, to turn the effect emulation off if a game misbehaves.

Experiment: 9.0 preview 2
Branch: release/v9.0
Commit: 1237629
Based on: main `d4cb896` (v8.8.1), plus 17 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-10 16:16 UTC

- New "Two cores (Experimental)" CPU option: faster than one core, with less heat and fewer performance cores than three.
- Gate CPU core modes by device capability
- On iPads without mesh shaders, geometry-shader and rectangle draws are now emulated instead of skipped, so effects that were missing show up.
- Make on-screen buttons easier to hit, and size each half separately
- Settings has a new switch, Emulate missing effects, to turn the effect emulation off if a game misbehaves.

Experiment: 9.0 preview
Branch: release/v9.0
Commit: bed1f7d
Based on: main `9535938` (v8.9), plus 8 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-10 15:31 UTC

- On iPad in portrait, the on-screen controls can now move further down the screen.
- On iPads without mesh shaders, geometry-shader and rectangle draws are now emulated instead of skipped, so effects that were missing show up.
- Let the shoulder buttons move the full available height
- Make on-screen buttons easier to hit, and size each half separately

Experiment: Store screenshot capture
Branch: feature/store-screenshots
Commit: f9fcd3d
Based on: main `446478d` (v7.9.1), plus 1 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-07 01:38 UTC

Experiment: Save states (same-session loads)
Branch: feature/save-states-stage0
Commit: 1a9129e
Based on: main `492ce96` (v7.2), plus 3 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-06 20:20 UTC

- Loading a save state now tells you exactly why it was refused, with an error code, and only says "loaded" once the game is drawing again.
- Loading a save state brings the graphics back in step with the restored game, and no longer gives up when the game is waiting on the screen to refresh.
- Loading a save state works after the game has started or stopped background tasks, and timers and sleeping threads carry on from where they were.

Experiment: Favour performance
Branch: feature/favour-performance
Commit: 5598a43
Based on: main `fd4fadf` (v6.7), plus 50 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-06 01:14 UTC

- Reset settings to defaults now also resets moved on-screen buttons and the Preview pad, and Let MuffinEMU choose again on the Emulated Clock now really returns to automatic.
- Settings sections are reordered so related options sit together and About is last.
- Playing Splatoon no longer turns on the on-screen sticks and the two-screen layout for your other games.
- Game options now show what each setting follows, say when changes apply, and can be reset to the global defaults in one tap.
- The performance overlay and notification text colour is now chosen with a colour picker instead of a hex code you could not type.
- Settings wording is clearer about what each option does and when it applies, and MoltenVK only shows when Vulkan is selected.
- Settings now explains why Account and Network Service are dimmed during a game, and when the Preview pad is being overridden by another control style.
- The Theme row in Settings now shows which theme is active, and the locked pro icon message points to Settings > Premium.
- The TV and GamePad volume sliders now work, including while a game is running.
- Turning on only VRAM usage or Debug in the overlay now shows it.
